Cards.Name: One card per action
Cards.Hint: Draw each item use as one chat card: portrait, title, folded description, and a full-width band for each roll. Turn off to keep dnd5e's cards.

TwoD20s.Name: Always roll two d20s
TwoD20s.Hint: Every d20 roll also rolls a second d20 in advance. Late advantage or disadvantage on the card uses it first.

RollAttackOnUse.Name: Roll the attack on use
RollAttackOnUse.Hint: Using an item with an attack rolls the attack into its card at once. Off: the attack is a button on the card.

RollDamageOnUse.Name: Roll damage on use
RollDamageOnUse.Hint: Damage rolls into the card at once: after each attack (doubled on a critical hit), and right after a save spell or a damage or healing activity. Off: damage is a button on the card.

NoRollDialogs.Name: No roll dialogs
NoRollDialogs.Hint: Rolls go straight to the card, without the roll configuration window. Hold the skip-dialog key (Shift) to get the window back. Spellcasting and activity choices still ask.

Card.ApplyNote: To selected tokens. Damage halves for each token that saved, if the spell says so.
